fn-night-02.back: Deep red light does not break down the night vision pigment. Bright red still can.

<rect x="0" y="0" width="400" height="300" fill="#fffaf0"/>

fn-night-03.front: Is a headlamp to walk out hunting with a light?
fn-night-03.back: No (90%, my reading). Using a light to find, hold or shoot game is unlawful.

fn-night-09.front: Tracking a wounded deer after legal light with rifle and headlamp?
fn-night-09.back: That is hunting after hours and with a light. See Blood trailing for what to do.

fn-night-10.front: Why not walk straight down a dark draw?
fn-night-10.back: Draws end in cliffs, creeks and blowdown (Tip).

fn-night-12.front: A swinging headlamp beam does what to game?
fn-night-12.back: It is pure motion. Keep the light low and steady.

fn-night-13.back: Help: three whistle blasts or three flashes (Tip).

fn-night-14.back: STOP, try compass to a known handrail, otherwise stay put, shelter, call.

fn-night-15.back: The three before dark: truck waypoint, back bearing, catching feature road.
